fb214510f2e9: Install and start tC4 · translationCore 4 Help
336b6d253f99: The download already has the source texts, the translation helps and the story pictures, so you can start without the internet.
55d32cce152c: Get the file for your computer from the tC4 releases page: the .exe for Windows, the .pkg for macOS (Apple silicon), or the .zip for Linux.
959302e86bc6: Windows: run the .exe. If Windows warns about an unknown app, choose More info, then Run anyway. Start tC4 from the Start menu.
07fe20e642df: macOS: open the .pkg. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. Then start translationCore 4 from Applications.
998a778cb76d: Linux: unpack the zip, open a terminal in the translationCore4 folder and run ./start-tc4.sh.
f6207d2df1e9: The first time, a small window says "Preparing translationCore4" and counts the resources, for example "Preparing resources: 2 of 16". Wait until it finishes. This can take a minute on a slow computer. Later starts are fast; the window shows only for a moment.
3a9b3349e4fd: tC4 opens on Home with the heading Your projects.
2e96ed61ac72: Click + Add a project to start your first project. See The Home screen.
e19852bfe40f: The warnings in step 2 appear because the installers are not signed yet. They only appear the first time.
7f04a0585c74: Installing a newer build: install it over the one you have; you don't need to remove the old one first. Your projects and settings stay where they are.
3ef92003c512: On macOS, if translationCore 4 is already on the Mac, the installer lists the copies it found and asks Replace it with this version? Your projects and settings stay where they are. Click Replace. Cancel (or no answer for 5 minutes) installs nothing, and the installer then says the installation failed. If an older copy can't be removed, the installer names it so you can move it to the Trash. The tC4 4.0 beta (translationCore4) is a different app and stays.
529ba5088d1e: On Windows, Setup installs over the older build in the same folder and removes the older build's program files first.
bd71cf0b68be: The window's menu bar has Edit, View and Window. Window › Reload reloads the screen.
8cae473cc72e: Windows says "The backend could not be started": install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64), then start tC4 again.
592d996d8137: Nothing new opens: only one copy of tC4 runs at a time. Starting it again brings back the window that is already open.
b8e3dc731fe9: "translationCore4 could not start … Bundled archive checksum mismatch": the download is damaged. Click OK, download it again and start the new copy.
faadeae3aad9: You closed tC4 while it was preparing: start it again. It continues and cleans up.
bd1b4e2eb7d4: Linux prints a line about "--no-sandbox": that is normal for the zip.
a32130b650a8: tC4 is still a pre-release. Keep a copy of important work elsewhere.
5a9c75cfdf9a: The small window Preparing translationCore4 on the first start: Getting resources ready for offline use. Preparing resources: 2 of 16.
c30d8ba223b7: Home the first time tC4 starts: the heading Your projects, the + Add a project button, and the message No projects yet. Select + Add a project to start.
